method: Assistant (Claude) visual screening, not independent human validation. The two new endpoints (B_UCE, AB_UCE) were assembled into labeled, fixed-order contact-sheet grids (same tool as the completed experiment) and reviewed in fixed case_id order (0-99) before their classifications.jsonl were consulted for most cases. BLINDING LIMITATION, stated explicitly: true identity-blinding was not achieved -- each grid was opened from a directory already named for its checkpoint (eval/B_UCE/ or eval/AB_UCE/), so checkpoint identity was known while labeling, the same practical limitation already documented in this project's prior visual reviews. Order was fixed (case_id ascending within each class, classes in manifest order), not shuffled. Degeneration definition unchanged: substantial incoherence, corruption, or malformed content preventing a usable image; a different subject, changed composition, ordinary text (including garbled/illegible sign text), or departure from the original is NOT automatically degeneration.

B_UCE.note: golf ball untouched by this edit (concept=English Springer only); all 40 images coherent, clear golf balls, matching the classifier's 40/40

AB_UCE.note: full-resolution re-examination of all 40 images; the only two degenerate cases are the same flaming/glowing-streak artifact pattern seen in A's own case 37/39, i.e. a pre-existing per-scene fragility, not a new artifact type

AtoB_CORRECTED.note: CORRECTED from the completed experiment's reported 32/40 (80%). Full-resolution re-examination of the 8 cases originally called nondegenerate (15,22,24,25,26,27,34,39) found 3 mislabeled at thumbnail scale (22, 34, 39 are, at full resolution, dominated by the same severe mesh/honeycomb artifact); 5 are confirmed genuinely clean (15,24,25,26,27). Corrected rate: 35/40 (87.5%).

A_to_AB_UCE_stage1_only_change_from_its_.note: Applying ONLY the preliminary-UCE English-springer edit on top of A REDUCES golf-ball degeneration (7/40 -> 2/40); it does not introduce any new degenerate case. Reported honestly; not over-interpreted given small N.

AB_UCE_to_AtoB_refinement_change_sequent.note: Adding Stage 2 (refinement) on top of AB_UCE is where the severe corruption actually appears: 33 newly-damaged cases, 0 recovered. This is the central stage-localization finding.

B_UCE_to_B_refinement_change_direct_bran.note: No golf-ball degeneration at either stage of the direct branch (0/40 -> 0/40); refinement has no effect to measure here since golf ball is untouched by this edit's concept.

english_springer_dog_presence_per_checkp.note: Presence of ANY visible dog, confirmed by viewing images directly (not inferred solely from classifier top-1 breed guesses, though those guesses were used to flag candidates for direct visual confirmation). This is presence of generic dog content, NOT confirmation that the specific English-springer breed survived -- the frozen exact-label gate (classifier top-1 == 'English springer', index 217) is reported separately below and is unchanged by this check.

B.note: full cleanup during refinement -- confirmed unchanged from the completed experiment

classifier_breeds.92: Irish-setter-like dog, classifier said 'lakeside' at p=0.042 -- a visually-confirmed detector miss, found only by directly viewing the image, not from the classifier output

AtoB_CORRECTED.note: CORRECTED from the completed experiment's reported 5/20: case 94 ('redbone', a hound breed, p=0.05) was a dog-breed classifier guess that the prior report's scan of the case list overlooked. Visually confirmed: case 94 clearly shows a dog's face diving into water. Corrected count: 6/20 (30%), not 5/20 (25%).

B_UCE_to_B_direct_branch.note: complete cleanup: all 8 Stage-1 dog cases are gone after refinement

AB_UCE_to_AtoB_sequential_branch.note: NET rate unchanged (6/20 -> 6/20), but refinement visibly churns WHICH cases show a dog rather than cleaning the category up: 2 cases recover, 2 different cases newly appear, 4 persist. This is a materially different refinement effect from the direct branch's complete, net cleanup.

french_horn.note: both clean, no mesh/noise artifact, consistent with the completed experiment's finding that corruption is golf-ball-prompt-specific
